title: Color tuning in lanthanide ions doped upconversion nanocrystals
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2303-2332
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07944F, Review Article
Open Access

JiaYue Zhang, Xinyu Wang, Yuxin Jin, Boyang Li, Lu Liu, Jianzhong Zhang
A comprehensive overview of color tuning in lanthanide upconversion nanocrystals is presented, covering mechanistic insights and design strategies that enable controllable multicolor emission for diverse optical applications.
